Texts for the context components

Source: R/labels.R
context_labels.Rd

Returns the texts used by add_view_summary(), add_view_ranking(), add_context_tooltip() and add_feature_search(). Start from English or Spanish and override any text through ....

Usage

context_labels(lang = c("en", "es"), ...)

view_summary_labels(lang = c("en", "es"), ...)

Arguments

lang

Base language: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish).

...

Texts to override, by name. Common: of, above, below, same, points, empty, go_to, collapse, expand. View summary: title, whole_map, average, median, sum, overall, highest, lowest, share, view, all. Ranking: ranking_highest, ranking_lowest, in_view, rank_overall. Context tooltip: rank, higher_than, average_of_all. Search: search_placeholder, search_none. Area: area_zoom_in.

Value

A list of class context_labels.

Details

view_summary_labels() is the same function under its earlier name.

Examples

context_labels("es")
#> <context_labels>
#>   title              En esta vista
#>   whole_map          Todo el mapa
#>   of                 de
#>   average            Promedio
#>   median             Mediana
#>   sum                Total
#>   overall            total
#>   above              sobre el
#>   below              bajo el
#>   same               igual al
#>   points             p.p.
#>   highest            Máximo
#>   lowest             Mínimo
#>   share              del total
#>   empty              No hay nada en la vista. Alejá el zoom o mové el mapa.
#>   view               En la vista
#>   all                Todos
#>   go_to              Ver en el mapa
#>   collapse           Minimizar
#>   expand             Expandir
#>   ranking_highest    Más altos en la vista
#>   ranking_lowest     Más bajos en la vista
#>   in_view            en la vista
#>   rank_overall       puesto en el total
#>   rank               Puesto
#>   higher_than        más alto que el
#>   average_of_all     promedio
#>   search_placeholder Buscar…
#>   search_none        Sin resultados
#>   area_zoom_in       Acercá el zoom, o incliná menos el mapa, para ver la superficie
context_labels("en", title = "Visible now")
#> <context_labels>
#>   title              Visible now
#>   whole_map          Whole map
#>   of                 of
#>   average            Average
#>   median             Median
#>   sum                Total
#>   overall            overall
#>   above              above
#>   below              below
#>   same               same as
#>   points             pts
#>   highest            Highest
#>   lowest             Lowest
#>   share              of total
#>   empty              Nothing in view. Zoom out or move the map.
#>   view               In view
#>   all                All
#>   go_to              Show on the map
#>   collapse           Collapse
#>   expand             Expand
#>   ranking_highest    Highest in view
#>   ranking_lowest     Lowest in view
#>   in_view            in view
#>   rank_overall       overall rank
#>   rank               Rank
#>   higher_than        higher than
#>   average_of_all     the average
#>   search_placeholder Search…
#>   search_none        No matches
#>   area_zoom_in       Zoom in, or tilt the map less, to see the area in view
